column1: # Hindi swar (vowels): letter <TAB> word <TAB> picture [<TAB> like]
# Words are picked so that an emoji shows exactly that thing (अनानास, not अनार, because
# there is no pomegranate emoji). "like" marks a letter no everyday word starts with;
# the card then reads "अः, जैसे छः" instead of "अः से ...".
